verdict.rationale: Meltano ships an official, documented CLI for managing projects, plugins, and EL(T) pipelines, including `meltano init`, `meltano add` (documented as idempotent), `meltano run`, and `meltano config test/list`. A probe confirms the CLI reference page, and a community comment independently calls it CLI-first. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances such as machine-readable/JSON output or explicit non-interactive modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Meltano provides a command line interface (CLI) that makes it easy to manage your project, plugins, and EL(T) pipelines.
`meltano add` lets you add or update [plugins](/concepts/plugins#project-plugins) in your Meltano project. The command is idempotent
You can run EL(T) pipelines using [`meltano run`]
Meltano is open source, self-hosted, CLI-first, debuggable, and extensible.
